# Comfy Headless

> Production-ready headless client for ComfyUI with AI-powered prompt intelligence

## Overview

Comfy Headless provides a Python API and Gradio UI for ComfyUI without the complexity. Six workflow profiles — Image, Video, 3D, Inference, Metadata, Audio — plus AI-powered prompt enhancement via Ollama, real-time WebSocket progress, and modular architecture with optional dependencies. Every emitted node type is verified against the live ComfyUI catalog; non-core nodes declare their custom node pack.

**In-repo knowledge base:** `kb/index.json` is a machine-readable index over per-profile fact pages, runnable reference graphs (`kb/workflows/*.json`), and node provenance (`kb/nodes.json`) — designed to be the first thing an LLM reads when working with this library. See `kb/README.md`.

## Quick Start

```bash
pip install comfy-headless[standard]  # Recommended: AI + WebSocket

# Or minimal install
pip install comfy-headless
```

```python
from comfy_headless import ComfyClient

client = ComfyClient("http://localhost:8188")
result = client.generate_image("cyberpunk cityscape at sunset")
print(result["images"])  # List of generated image paths
```

## Installation Options

| Extra | Includes |
|-------|----------|
| `[ai]` | Ollama prompt enhancement |
| `[websocket]` | Real-time progress updates |
| `[health]` | System health monitoring |
| `[ui]` | Gradio web interface |
| `[validation]` | Pydantic config validation |
| `[observability]` | OpenTelemetry tracing |
| `[standard]` | ai + websocket (recommended) |
| `[full]` | All features |

## Core API

### ComfyClient(base_url=None, rate_limit=None, rate_limit_per_seconds=1.0)
Main client for ComfyUI interaction. `base_url` defaults to config settings.

```python
client = ComfyClient("http://localhost:8188")
```

### client.generate_image(prompt, ...)
Generate an image.
- `prompt`: Text description
- `negative_prompt`: What to avoid (default `""`)
- `preset`: Preset name — overrides width/height/steps/cfg when set
  (`draft`, `fast`, `quality`, `hd`, `portrait`, `landscape`, `cinematic`, `square`)
- `checkpoint`: Model checkpoint name
- `width`, `height`: Dimensions (default 1024)
- `steps`: Sampling steps (default 20)
- `cfg`: Guidance strength (default 7.0)
- `sampler`, `scheduler`: Defaults `"euler"`, `"normal"`
- `seed`: `-1` for random
- `wait`, `timeout`, `on_progress`: Completion control
- Returns: `dict` with keys `success`, `prompt_id`, `images`, `error`, `seed`, `preset`

### client.generate_video(prompt, preset="standard", ...)
Generate a video. See Video Generation below.
- Returns: `dict` with keys `success`, `prompt_id`, `videos`, `error`, `seed`, `preset`

### client.generate_batch(prompts, preset="fast", ...)
Generate multiple images from a list of prompts.
- `prompts`: List of prompt strings
- `seeds`: Optional list of seeds
- `max_concurrent`, `check_vram`, `on_progress`
- Returns: `dict`

### client.upload_image(path_or_bytes, *, filename=None, subfolder="", overwrite=False, type="input")
Upload an image into ComfyUI's input folder via `POST /upload/image`. Required
before any workflow that takes a source image.
- `path_or_bytes`: local file path or raw bytes
- Returns: `dict` with keys `name`, `subfolder`, `type`, `ref`
- `name` is the server's stored filename and is authoritative — ComfyUI renames
  on collision, so it may differ from what was sent. `ref` is `name` pre-joined
  with `subfolder`, ready to pass as a `LoadImage` node's `image` input.

### client.upload_mask(path_or_bytes, original_ref, ...)
Upload a mask via `POST /upload/mask`, compositing it into an existing image's
alpha channel. `original_ref` accepts the dict returned by `upload_image` or a
bare filename.

### client.get_history(prompt_id=None)
Get execution history, optionally for a specific prompt.
- Returns: `dict`

### client.generate_3d(image, preset="standard", ...)
Image-to-mesh via Hunyuan3D-2 (all core nodes, no packs). `image` accepts a
local path, raw bytes, an `upload_image()` dict, or a server-side ref —
local sources are uploaded automatically.
- Presets: `standard`, `draft`, `detail`; overrides: `steps`, `cfg`, `seed`,
  `octree_resolution`, `threshold`, ...
- Returns: `dict` with keys `success`, `prompt_id`, `meshes` (GLB file
  entries for `get_file()`), `error`, `seed`, `preset`

### client.generate_audio(tags, lyrics="", preset="music", ...)
Text-to-music via ACE-Step 1.5 (all core, MIT weights). `tags` is the main
prompt; `lyrics` optional.
- Presets: `music`, `music_long`, `jingle`, `music_mp3`, `draft`;
  overrides: `seconds`, `bpm`, `keyscale`, `format` (flac/mp3/opus), ...
- Returns: `dict` with keys `success`, `prompt_id`, `audios`, `error`,
  `seed`, `preset`

### client.separate_audio(audio, stems=None, ...)
Split audio into stems (bass, drums, other, vocals). Requires the
`audio-separation-nodes-comfyui` pack. `audio` accepts path/bytes/dict/ref
(uploads via `upload_audio` automatically).
- Returns: `dict` with `audios` (each entry labeled with its `stem`)

### client.run_inference(image, task="caption", text_input="", ...)
Non-generative inference via Florence-2: `caption`, `detailed_caption`,
`more_detailed_caption`, `tag`, `detect`, `segment`, `ocr`. `detect` and
`segment` require `text_input` (what to find). Requires the
`comfyui-florence2` pack (+ `comfyui-segment-anything-2` for detect).
- Returns: `dict` with `text` (the inline result — caption/tags/coordinates,
  no second round-trip), `texts`, `files`, `images` (segment masks), `error`

### client.edit_image(prompt, images, ...)
Instruction-based editing via Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. `images` is 1-3
references (paths/bytes/dicts/refs).
- Returns: `dict` with `success`, `prompt_id`, `images`, `error`, `seed`

### client.rerun_from_png(source, ...)
Re-run the exact API-format graph embedded in a ComfyUI output PNG
(metadata profile). Returns every output family: `images`, `videos`,
`audios`, `meshes`, `files`, `texts`.

### client.upload_audio(path_or_bytes, ...)
Upload audio into ComfyUI's input folder (same `POST /upload/image` route —
no audio-specific route exists). Same return shape as `upload_image`.

### client.get_file(filename, subfolder="", folder_type="output")
Download ANY generated output (mesh, audio, text, video) via `GET /view` —
one route serves every output type.

### client.queue_prompt(workflow, extra_pnginfo=None)
Queue a raw API-format workflow. `extra_pnginfo` embeds custom provenance
keys as PNG text chunks in the outputs (metadata profile write path).

### client.check_workflow_types(workflow)
Client-side edge type validation against the live `/object_info`, using the
server's own union-superset acceptance rule (a MESH into a FILE_3D_* union
is never a false rejection). Returns `{checked, errors, warnings}`.

### Module-level profile builders

```python
from comfy_headless import (
    build_3d_workflow,            # 3D: image_ref -> Hunyuan3D-2 graph
    build_audio_workflow,         # Audio: tags/lyrics -> ACE-Step 1.5 graph
    build_audio_separation_workflow,
    build_inference_workflow,     # Inference: caption/tag/detect/segment/ocr
    build_qwen_edit_workflow,     # Image: Qwen-Edit-2511 (1-3 references)
    build_controlnet_workflow,    # Image: union ControlNet (qwen or sdxl base)
    compile_workflow,             # Image: templates incl. "qwen_txt2img"
    build_video_workflow,         # Video: 26 presets
)
```

### Metadata / provenance (module-level, no server needed)

```python
from comfy_headless import read_workflow_metadata, extract_prompt_graph

record = read_workflow_metadata("output.png")   # .prompt .workflow .extra
graph = extract_prompt_graph("output.png")      # the re-POSTable /prompt graph
```

### enhance_prompt(prompt, style="balanced")
AI-powered prompt enhancement via Ollama. Module-level function, **not** a client
method. Requires the `[ai]` extra.

```python
from comfy_headless import enhance_prompt

result = enhance_prompt("a cat", style="balanced")
print(result.enhanced)  # EnhancedPrompt: .original .enhanced .negative .additions .reasoning
```

### Listing presets
Module-level functions, **not** client methods.

```python
from comfy_headless import list_presets, list_video_presets

list_presets()        # Image presets
list_video_presets()  # Video presets
```

## Video Generation

26 presets across 9 model families (`VIDEO_PRESETS`, `VIDEO_MODEL_INFO`):
- AnimateDiff (v2, v3, Lightning)
- Stable Video Diffusion (SVD, SVD-XT)
- CogVideoX
- Hunyuan Video
- Hunyuan Video 1.5
- LTX Video
- Wan
- Mochi

Selection is by `preset`, not by model name:

```python
result = client.generate_video(
    prompt="ocean waves crashing",
    preset="wan_14b",   # e.g. quick, standard, quality, cinematic,
                        # svd_short, cogvideo, hunyuan, ltx_quality,
                        # wan_14b, mochi, ...
    frames=48,          # optional override
    fps=24,             # optional override
)
print(result["videos"])
```

For image-to-video, `init_image` is a **server-side filename**, not image data —
upload first and pass the returned `name`:

```python
ref = client.upload_image("reference.png")
result = client.generate_video("a cat walking", preset="wan_14b", init_image=ref["name"])
```

Most video presets run on stock ComfyUI core nodes. AnimateDiff presets need
AnimateDiff-Evolved, CogVideoX needs the CogVideoX Wrapper, and video output uses
Video Helper Suite by default — or pass `output="core"` to swap the terminator to
core `CreateVideo -> SaveVideo` and drop that pack entirely. Hunyuan 1.5
image-to-video is real i2v via `hunyuan15_i2v` / `hunyuan15_i2v_fast` presets
(requires `init_image`). Check dependencies before running with
`client.check_workflow_dependencies(workflow)` (reports `missing_packs`) or
`client.require_workflow_dependencies(workflow)` (raises `MissingNodePackError`).

## Gradio UI

```bash
# Launch web interface (the default action)
comfy-headless

# Flags: --port/-p (default 7861), --share, --url,
#        --version/-v, --check, --diagnose
```

```python
# Or programmatically (requires the [ui] extra)
from comfy_headless import launch
launch(port=7861, share=False)
```

6 top-level tabs: Image, Video, Queue & History, Workflows, Models, Settings
(Workflows nests Browse, Presets, Import, Create)

## Configuration

Environment variables use the `COMFY_HEADLESS_` prefix with `__` section delimiters:
- `COMFY_HEADLESS_COMFYUI__URL`: ComfyUI server URL (default: http://localhost:8188)
- `COMFY_HEADLESS_OLLAMA__URL`: Ollama server URL (default: http://localhost:11434)
- `COMFY_HEADLESS_OLLAMA__MODEL`: Ollama model (default: qwen2.5:7b)
- `COMFY_HEADLESS_COMFYUI__TIMEOUT_READ`: Read timeout in seconds
- `COMFY_HEADLESS_LOGGING__LEVEL`: Log level

## Key Features

- Connection pooling with retry logic
- Circuit breaker for resilience
- WebSocket real-time progress
- Structured logging with OpenTelemetry
- Input validation and sanitization
- Secrets management utilities
- Temporary file cleanup
